description.de: Die tabellarische Übersicht dient zur Erfüllung der Berichterstattung aus dem Berliner Energiewendegesetz (EWG Bln.). Hierbei werden die Energieverbräuche (Wärme und Strom) der bezirklichen Abnahmestellen (Liegenschaften, Gebäude und Einzelobjekte) aufgelistet.
description.fi: Taulukon avulla täytetään Berliinin energiasiirtymälain (EWG Bln.) raportointi. Tässä luetellaan alueen vastaanottopisteiden (kiinteistöt, rakennukset ja yksittäiset kohteet) energiankulutus (lämpö ja sähkö).
description.pt: O quadro geral serve para cumprir os relatórios da Lei de Transição Energética de Berlim (EWG Bln.). Aqui, é apresentado o consumo de energia (calor e eletricidade) dos pontos de receção distritais (propriedades, edifícios e objetos individuais).
description.bg: Табличният преглед служи за изпълнение на докладването от Берлинския закон за енергиен преход (EWG Bln.). Тук са изброени потреблението на енергия (топлинна и електрическа енергия) на областните приемни пунктове (имоти, сгради и отделни обекти).
description.lt: Lentelės apžvalga skirta Berlyno energetikos pertvarkos akto (EWG Bln.) ataskaitoms parengti. Čia išvardijamas rajono priėmimo punktų (savybių, pastatų ir atskirų objektų) energijos suvartojimas (šiluma ir elektra).
description.lv: Tabulas pārskats kalpo, lai izpildītu Berlīnes Enerģētikas pārkārtošanas likuma (EWG Bln.) ziņojumus. Šeit ir uzskaitīts rajona pieņemšanas punktu (īpašumu, ēku un atsevišķu objektu) enerģijas patēriņš (siltumenerģija un elektroenerģija).
description.hr: Tabelarni pregled služi za ispunjavanje izvješća iz Berlinskog zakona o energetskoj tranziciji (EWG Bln.). Ovdje se navodi potrošnja energije (toplina i električna energija) u okružnim prihvatnim točkama (objekti, zgrade i pojedinačni objekti).
description.fr: L'aperçu sous forme de tableau sert à remplir les rapports de la loi berlinoise sur la transition énergétique (EWG Bln.). Les consommations d'énergie (chaleur et électricité) des points de consommation régionaux (immeubles, bâtiments et objets individuels) y sont répertoriées.
description.hu: A táblázatos áttekintés a berlini energetikai átállásról szóló törvény (EWG Bln.) szerinti jelentéstétel teljesítését szolgálja. Itt a kerületi átvételi pontok (ingatlanok, épületek és egyedi objektumok) energiafogyasztását (hő és villamos energia) soroljuk fel.
description.uk: Табличний огляд служить для виконання звітності з Берлінського закону про енергетичний перехід (EWG Bln.). Тут перераховані енергоспоживання (тепло та електроенергія) районних пунктів приймання (властивості, будівлі та окремі об'єкти).
description.sk: Tabuľkový prehľad slúži na plnenie správ z berlínskeho zákona o energetickej transformácii (EWG Bln.). Tu je uvedená spotreba energie (teplo a elektrina) okresných akceptačných miest (nehnuteľnosti, budovy a jednotlivé objekty).
description.sl: Tabelarični pregled služi izpolnjevanju poročanja iz Berlinskega zakona o energetskem prehodu (EWG Bln.). Tukaj je navedena poraba energije (toplota in elektrika) na sprejemnih točkah okrožja (nepremičnine, stavbe in posamezni objekti).
description.ga: Leis an bhforbhreathnú táblach, comhlíontar an tuairisciú ó Ghníomh um Aistriú Fuinnimh Bheirlín (EWG Bln.). Anseo, liostaítear ídiú fuinnimh (teas agus leictreachas) na bpointí glactha ceantair (maoin, foirgnimh agus réada aonair).
description.sv: Tabellöversikten tjänar till att uppfylla rapporteringen från Berlins energiomställningslag (EWG Bln.). Här listas energiförbrukningen (värme och el) för distriktsacceptanspunkterna (fastigheter, byggnader och enskilda objekt).
description.mt: Il-ħarsa ġenerali tabulari sservi biex tissodisfa r-rapportar mill-Att ta’ Berlin dwar it-Tranżizzjoni tal-Enerġija (EWG Bln.). Hawnhekk, huwa elenkat il-konsum tal-enerġija (sħana u elettriku) tal-punti ta’ aċċettazzjoni distrettwali (proprjetajiet, bini u oġġetti individwali).
description.el: Η επισκόπηση σε πίνακα χρησιμεύει για την εκπλήρωση των υποχρεώσεων που απορρέουν από τον νόμο του Βερολίνου για την ενεργειακή μετάβαση (EWG Bln.). Εδώ παρατίθεται η κατανάλωση ενέργειας (θερμότητα και ηλεκτρική ενέργεια) των σημείων αποδοχής της περιοχής (ιδιότητες, κτίρια και μεμονωμένα αντικείμενα).
description.en: The tabular overview serves to fulfil the reporting from the Berlin Energy Transition Act (EWG Bln.). Here, the energy consumption (heat and electricity) of the district acceptance points (properties, buildings and individual objects) are listed.
description.it: La panoramica tabellare serve a soddisfare le relazioni della legge di transizione energetica di Berlino (EWG Bln.). Qui sono elencati i consumi energetici (calore ed elettricità) dei punti di accettazione del distretto (proprietà, edifici e singoli oggetti).
description.es: El resumen tabular sirve para cumplir con los informes de la Ley de Transición Energética de Berlín (EWG Bln.). Aquí se enumera el consumo de energía (calor y electricidad) de los puntos de aceptación del distrito (propiedades, edificios y objetos individuales).
description.et: Tabeli ülevaate eesmärk on täita Berliini energiasüsteemi ümberkujundamise seaduse (EWG Bln.) aruandlust. Siin on loetletud piirkonna vastuvõtupunktide (kinnisvara, hooned ja üksikobjektid) energiatarbimine (soojus ja elekter).
description.cs: Tabulkový přehled slouží ke splnění zprávy z berlínského zákona o transformaci energetiky (EWG Bln.). Zde je uvedena spotřeba energie (teplo a elektřina) okresních akceptačních míst (vlastnosti, budovy a jednotlivé objekty).
description.pl: Tabelaryczny przegląd służy wypełnieniu sprawozdań z berlińskiej ustawy o transformacji energetycznej (EWG Bln.). W tym miejscu wymieniono zużycie energii (ciepła i energii elektrycznej) przez lokalne punkty odbioru (nieruchomości, budynki i poszczególne obiekty).
description.ro: Prezentarea generală tabelară servește la îndeplinirea raportării din Legea privind tranziția energetică de la Berlin (EWG Bln.). Aici sunt enumerate consumul de energie (căldură și electricitate) al punctelor de recepție districtuale (proprietăți, clădiri și obiecte individuale).
description.da: Tabeloversigten tjener til at opfylde rapporteringen fra Berlin Energy Transition Act (EWG Bln.). Her vises energiforbruget (varme og elektricitet) for distriktets acceptpunkter (ejendomme, bygninger og individuelle genstande).
description.nl: Het overzicht in tabelvorm dient om te voldoen aan de rapportage uit de Berlijnse Energietransitiewet (EWG Bln.). Hier wordt het energieverbruik (warmte en elektriciteit) van de wijkacceptatiepunten (eigendommen, gebouwen en individuele objecten) vermeld.

method: pdf: requested 450, available 440 in archives 000/001 with 100B–2MiB cap.
xls: requested 160, available 93 in archives 000/001 with 100B–2MiB cap.

Fixed archives 000 and 001; sorted member names; format quotas then fill; no original parsed. Neutral generic names because the archive publishes no document titles. Language is corpus-level English, not a per-file classifier. No page counts published for these members.

Existing fetch_enron_raw_sample seed=20261102 n_docs=500 min_words=60 selects distinct bodies; original raw RFC822 member bytes preserved as .eml. Subject-based names. The sampler deduplicates exact bodies, but related thread messages remain.
Eight messages with blank Subject headers use neutral Untitled message names instead of the existing sampler's body-introduction fallback titles.
Disambiguate two RE/Re case-only mail filename pairs with ordinary copy suffixes for portability on case-insensitive filesystems; opaque IDs and bytes unchanged.

No DIP API key used. Direct public document server; fixed-seed random three-number runs over Wahlperioden 18/19/20. No published page counts accompany direct-server PDFs; no PDF parsing performed. Small number runs retained instead of metadata-linked parliamentary families.

Retain 405 sampled Drucksachen and include 45 public Plenarprotokolle: seed 20261102, 15 per Wahlperiode 18/19/20, sampled session numbers 1–200; document-server PDFs unaltered, no accompanying published page counts.

Published Cellar RDF SPARQL metadata: 2013–2019 regulations sorted by CELEX, first 200 acts with German and English expressions. Content retrieved as XHTML using the Publications Office Cellar-backed download-handler (productionSystem=cellar); direct /resource content negotiation returned 404. Exact original XHTML bytes retained as .html. Language pairs provide near-duplicate families; no credentials, browser or EUR-Lex website used.

Add PDF counterparts for the first five acts (no page counts published with these downloads) and up to ten consolidated bilingual versions where metadata is cheaply available. All via the same Cellar-backed handler.

GovData CKAN robots disallows automated access. Substitute the published GovData catalogue harvested by data.europa.eu, API search with catalog=govdata and format XLSX/CSV; only explicit distribution dl-by-de/2.0 or dl-zero-de/2.0 licences; <=512kB resources; German original title required. Distribution licence evidence retained per file.
Freeze a CSV complement from the same harvested GovData metadata and retain XLSX files to total 200; no further requests used to select the complement.

Audit all selected resource URLs against RFC wildcard/terminal robots rules; replace forbidden query-parameter downloads with other explicitly dl-de-licensed GovData resources. 4 candidate URLs excluded by robots.
Selection unchanged: published category HTML listings, four energy/climate categories per language; 125 English and 55 German article revisions.

Fetch each recorded revision from /wiki/TITLE?oldid=REV (robots-permitted). Raw HTML SHA-256 and length record the acquisition response as information only; rendering and skin bytes may vary. Derived document SHA-256 and length are authoritative and checked before caching and on materialization. Any derived-byte change is refused; revisions are never silently advanced.

wikipedia-note retains the paragraph-only Markdown derivation. wikipedia-html saves deterministic minimal article HTML: title, headings, paragraphs, lists and tables from mw-parser-output; no skin, navigation, scripts, styles, edit links or banners. Only Wikipedia HTML is interpreted; other sources retain strict raw-artifact checksums.

Published tika-20230714 metadata tika_eval_lang=deu and parse_status=OK, num_pages 1–40, joined to cc-provenance-20230303 by url_id; .de/.at/.ch hosts, <=2MiB; ascending file_name among first 10k. Original PDFs only archive-routed and hashed, never parsed. Published provenance digest checked. Neutral generic names, original URL retained separately.

shortfalls.reason: 125 English and 55 German notes met size/word limits in the chosen related categories; stop after category exhaustion/rate limits. 28% reduction, within the allowed 30%. No rate-limit retries.

share_adjustments.reason: Add 10 PDF counterparts and 20 consolidated language versions to 200 bilingual acts; cheaply available from Cellar.

policy.bytes: No source document bytes in Git. Only archive routing, hashing and copying for GovDocs1/SafeDocs; document extraction belongs to the engine sandbox.
policy.page_cap: 40 when published page counts are available (SafeDocs). Direct Bundestag and selected GovDocs1/Cellar originals have no accompanying page counts.
policy.names: Source titles/printed numbers or neutral generic names; manifest owns path-to-document identity. No opaque or dataset-internal identifiers in any path.
policy.mutable_upstream: Pinned document SHA-256 and length are authoritative. Wikipedia uses recorded revisions and verifies derived files; raw Wikipedia HTML checksums are informational. All other sources also require exact raw artifact SHA-256 and length. Derived-byte drift is refused rather than silently refreshing a recipe.

slice_selection.method: Seven-source, ten-format known-item slice; choose three 500–5000-byte GovData CSV tables after the real engine measured 3.16 million extracted characters in the initial three CSV candidates. Full corpus retains all candidates; sampling avoids large table expansion in this first CPU slice.
slice_selection.engine_measurement: Initial CSV extraction sizes: 2339874, 412143, 411303 characters. Metadata and source bytes otherwise unchanged.
